records.description: Luminom is the memorial and funeral app that families can use to preserve, share and rediscover stories, photos and voices of the deceased. Available worldwide for iOS. Soon Android.

records.name: Appunty — Organización al Aprender
records.tagline: Pierde menos tiempo organizando. Gana más aprendiendo.
records.description: Appunty es la plataforma para estudiantes y profesionales que quieren organizar apuntes, crear flashcards, estudiar con IA Feynman y potenciar su aprendizaje desde cualquier fuente.

records.name: Tariflo
records.tagline: AI-powered HS code classification and trade intelligence
records.description: Tariflo is an AI-powered trade intelligence platform that helps businesses instantly classify products using HS codes & access global trade compliance guidance. Every internationally traded product must have an HS code, which determines duties, taxes, & regulatory requirements. Today, finding the correct classification is complex, manual, & error-prone. Designed for exporters, importers, logistics providers, manufacturers, & global merchants.

records.name: recallmcp.com
records.tagline: Persistent memory for CC - install once, remember forever
records.description: Give your AI agents persistent memory. Semantic search, multi-tenant isolation, and MCP protocol support.

records.name: MemoryLoop
records.tagline: Never forget what you Learn!
records.description: MemoryLoop allows you to turn daily learnings and stories into long term memory by using spaced-repetition. Users input their learnings each day, test themselves on what they've learned, and improve their retention ability!

records.name: Ollama Explorer
records.tagline: Find the right local AI model for your hardware instantly
records.description: Ollama has 200+ open-source AI models — but finding the right one is painful. Ollama Explorer fixes that. Filter by use case (coding, reasoning, RAG, vision), domain, RAM requirement, parameter size, and context length. Each model shows hardware needs, pull counts, and recommended tasks. No signup. No ads. Just a fast, open-source tool to find the model that fits your machine.

records.name: rebon — Walk to Unlock Your Phone
records.tagline: Walk to unlock your phone. No skip button. Just walk.
records.description: rebon locks your addictive apps — Instagram, YouTube, TikTok — until you hit your daily step goal. No skip button. No workaround. Just walk. Set your step goal, pick the apps to lock, and start walking. Your apps stay locked until you move. It's that simple. Unlike other screen time apps with easy "skip" or "5 more minutes" buttons, rebon gives you zero escape. The only way to unlock is to walk. Users report screen time dropping from 6 hours to under 3 hours.

records.name: All Good – Check In Alerts
records.tagline: Check in, stay connected
records.description: AllGood — A Gentle Check-in, Peace of Mind for Those Who Care Living alone for a long time, it’s not always about danger. Sometimes, it’s simply that no one has asked, “Are you okay?” for a while. AllGood is made for moments like that. It doesn’t ask you to constantly report where you are, and it doesn’t interrupt the people who care about you. All you need to do is gently tap “Check in” at the time you choose.

records.name: Wedding and Event Planner
records.tagline: Free Wedding and Events planner app
records.description: Plan your wedding or event organization with ease. Organizing an event doesn't have to be stressful and this app helps by creating a checklist, add guests to a guest list and add into the seats and table planner, add a budget & calculate expenses. All in one free Wedding and Event Planner.

records.name: RawVamp: The Dark Aesthetic Photo Editor
records.tagline: Ultimate dark aesthetic, Y2K glitch and grunge photo editor
records.description: RawVamp is a client-side digital darkroom for creating authentic Y2K glitch, webcore artifacts, and dark aesthetics directly in your browser. It features 100+ curated presets (Gothic VHS, Cyber Halftone, Pixel Decay) powered entirely by WebGL. Zero cloud uploads means absolute privacy. Simply drag and drop your images into our web app for instant, lossless digital decay. Export your art in stunning 4K resolution to fuel your creative vision. Stop using generic filters. Embrace the glitch.

records.name: SpeakScope
records.tagline: AI Risk Shield: Audit Gigs & Ideas in Seconds
records.description: Freelancers and clients lose big on vague briefs—scope creep, hidden risks, and overruns. SpeakScope is a subscription-based Telegram bot that turns chaotic voice/text messages into pro docs in seconds. Core features: 1. Risk Audit: Green/Yellow/Red verdict flags ambiguities, scope creep, and red flags. 2. Technical Specification: Generates structured PRD/SOW/TOR 3. Time + Cost Estimation Perfect for freelancers spotting bad gigs, or clients testing ideas before hiring.

records.name: Crypto Breakout Predictor
records.tagline: get your daily top 5 coins most likely to pump!
records.description: I spent months searching for a simple tool that could show me which cryptocurrencies had the best chance of rising, without endless charts, confusing indicators, or financial jargon. Everything I found online was either too expensive, overly complicated, or designed for professionals. So I decided to create my own solution. The Crypto Breakout Predictor is a beginner-friendly tool that gives you a clear daily overview of the Top 5 coins most likely to break out.

records.name: MasterAI Store Builder
records.tagline: Launch conversion-ready WooCommerce store in 5 mins with AI.
records.description: AI-Powered Generation: Built-in Google Gemini AI to write your product copy and Puter.js to generate product images. Industry Templates: Whether you sell Fashion, Food, Digital goods, or Industrial parts, we have a custom-tailored flow for you. Niche Focus: Includes a specialized "Industrial Mode" for B2B stores needing specific filters (Diameter, Material, etc) Pro Features: Competitor Analyzer, Cart Recovery, and Multi-Currency support to help you scale from Day 1 Stop building. Start selling.

records.name: PEA OS - Pro Engineer Assistant
records.tagline: Automate AutoCAD and your engineering workflows with AI.
records.description: PEA OS is a comprehensive, AI-integrated desktop environment designed to streamline complex engineering tasks. Unlike standard tools, it unites 25+ disciplines into a single app without collecting user data. Key features include an AI assistant for technical reasoning, dynamic AutoLISP generation for instant AutoCAD automation, and a vast materials library. Built for professionals seeking a fast, private, and cohesive engineering ecosystem.

records.name: Levex
records.tagline: AI life companion for clarity, habits, and budgeting money
records.description: Levex: Your calm companion for intentional living. Navigate your finances, build positive habits, and gain clarity with AI-powered guidance. Think better, live calmer.

records.name: Ergate AI
records.tagline: Turn client briefs into winning proposals in 5 minutes
records.description: If you're a freelancer, consultant, or agency, you know the drill. A client sends a brief. You spend 2-4 hours analyzing requirements, estimating hours, building pricing, and writing the actual proposal. Then you do it again for the next one. And the next. Your win rate depends on how much time you had that week. Analyzes => Scopes => Writes a proposal Adjust pricing line by line, tweak the timeline, refine the language then export as a branded PDF/DOCX or share via a link with view tracking.

records.name: FreeWebToApk
records.tagline: Convert any website to Android APK instantly
records.description: Stop paying $99-$500 to turn your website into an app. FreeWebToApk generates Android APK/AAB files in 2 seconds - 100% free, forever. What sets us apart: 🚀 Instant generation (not hours/days) 💰 Built-in AdMob monetization 🔔 OneSignal push notifications 🎨 Custom branding (icons, splash screens) 📱 Play Store ready (AAB support) 🌐 Works offline Supports any website: WordPress, Shopify, Wix, HTML5 games, PWAs. No coding required. No account needed. Just convert and publish.

records.name: Planndu: AI Task Planning
records.tagline: Generate to-do lists in seconds and organize your thoughts.
records.description: Planndu AI takes your goals and turns them into structured, actionable to-do lists so you spend less time organizing and more time achieving. With built-in focus timers and reminders, finishing what you start has never been easier.

records.name: ProspectX
records.tagline: Find qualified leads and launch outreach in minutes
records.description: ProspectX is a SaaS for founders and teams to build targeted lead lists and run personalized outreach fast. Find prospects, generate tailored messages, launch sequences, and track replies and outcomes in one place. Built to reduce manual prospecting and help you iterate on what converts.

records.name: Play Console Pricing Adjuster
records.tagline: Set global Google Play prices using Purchasing Power Parity.
records.description: Launch smarter global pricing in minutes. Play Console Pricing Adjuster automatically recalculates and applies country-specific app prices using Purchase Power Parity (PPP) data — directly inside Google Play Console. No spreadsheets. No manual country edits. No guesswork. Update 160+ countries in one pass, switch billing currencies automatically, and apply fair, revenue-optimized prices worldwide. Built for indie developers who want global growth without global headaches. 🌍

records.name: Edgentra
records.tagline: AI Landing Pages. From Your Phone.
records.description: Build AI-powered conversational landing pages in 30 seconds. Perfect for MVP launches, Instagram funnels, and startup waitlists — fully mobile, embeddable landing pages directly from your phone.

records.name: FormTray
records.tagline: Easy and budget friendly form builder built for small teams
records.description: Formtray stands out by being right-sized for individuals, enterpreneurs and small teams. We focus on what small teams actually use (surveys, lead capture, registrations, feedback) instead of enterprise bloat or pricing. One may try out form building without signing up.

records.name: Trust Wallet Clone
records.tagline: High-Security Crypto Wallet Clone Script
records.description: A Trust Wallet Clone Script is a ready-made app like Trust Wallet. It lets users store, send, and receive many cryptocurrencies safely. It supports DeFi apps, NFTs, and token swaps. Users control their own private keys and recovery phrases, so their funds stay secure. The app is customizable, easy to launch, and helps businesses quickly create their own crypto wallet platform.

records.name: The John Hat - Old Daddin'
records.tagline: The John Hat - Old Daddin'
records.description: The John Hat by Old Daddin’ blends timeless style and comfort with a grey and black mesh design. Featuring the signature "Old Daddin’" logo, this hat is perfect for the modern dad looking to embrace laid-back vibes with a touch of personality. Whether you're enjoying a weekend outing or just kicking back, The John Hat adds a bold statement to your casual look. Get your Old Daddin’ hat today and wear your dad pride with style!

records.name: Clonespace
records.tagline: The AI Clone Social Network
records.description: Clonespace is the first AI social network where profiles are the AI. Talk to clones of Elon Musk, Tesla, Steve Jobs, Marcus Aurelius, and more — or create your own clone trained on your knowledge, personality, and expertise. Unlike chatbots, your clone lives on the platform 24/7, interacts with others, and represents you. Future versions: voice cloning for calls, face cloning for video. The digital twin era starts here.

records.name: The Last Ninja Quiz — C64 Edition
records.tagline: C64 nostalgia quiz with SID - prove you're a real ninja 🥷
records.description: I’ve been obsessed with Last Ninja since I was a kid. Prove you’re a real ninja: https://last-ninja-quiz.vercel.app

records.name: The 99¢ Community — 99 Cents. one time.
records.tagline: AI only gets smarter. 99 cents. Monthly winners ( VIP ).
records.description: Self-improving AI that predicts sports games and gets smarter after every single one. 571 games tracked, 359 wins, 62.9% accuracy — every prediction public, wins AND losses. STRONG picks hit at 78.2%. NCAAB is on a 10-game win streak. +20% flat-bet ROI. Covers NFL, NHL, NBA, NCAAB, Tennis — every sport coming. Competitors charge $50/month and hide their losses. We charge 99¢ once, lifetime access, and publish everything. The AI is learning right now.

records.name: PromptVault - Prompt Manager
records.tagline: Organize, reuse, and master your prompts with AI
records.description: PromptVault is a free, offline-first prompt manager built for serious AI users. Unlike most prompt apps, it supports on-device AI models for private generation and also integrates with Ollama Cloud for powerful remote models. You can organize prompts with tags, collections, variables, and favorites, then use them anywhere with PromptVault Web on any screen. Secure backups, Drive sync, and true offline mode make it a complete productivity tool for AI creators.

records.name: Vocady.ai
records.tagline: Write What You See. Everything Else Is Organized for You.
records.description: Vocady helps you review what you learn in offline language classes. Just write any word or sentence as you see it, and the app automatically finds the base form, part of speech, meaning, grammar notes, and example sentences. Your notes are turned into quick quizzes so you can study anytime, even on the bus or subway. It’s especially useful for heavily conjugated languages like Spanish. Supports Korean, English, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, German, French, Italian, and Russian.

records.name: Coulson.app
records.tagline: Local dev gateway with .local domains, LAN access & tunnels
records.description: Coulson gives every local project alocal domain. No more localhost:port. echo 3000 > ~/.coulson/myapp → http://myapp.coulson.local - Symlink a Python/Node.js project, server auto-starts on first request - Toggle LAN Access, phone/tablet can reach it via mDNS - coulson tunnel start myapp — instant Cloudflare Tunnel public URL - Built-in request inspector for webhook debugging - One command for local HTTPS Rust + Pingora + Swift. Open source.

records.name: Yoga Classes Milwaukee
records.tagline: Elite Sports Clubs offers premier Yoga Classes Milwaukee
records.description: Elite Sports Clubs offers premier Yoga Classes Milwaukee residents trust for strength, flexibility, and stress relief. Our expert instructors guide all skill levels through dynamic and restorative sessions in a welcoming environment, helping members improve balance, mobility, and overall wellness every day.

records.name: Helvet CV
records.tagline: The Best CV to bypass AI screening
records.description: Unlike generic builders, Helvet CV analyzes the specific Job Description and re-engineers your profile in real-time. We optimize for the exact semantic requirements of modern ATS, ensuring your CV ranks in the top 1% of the screening pile. Furthermore the System never lose track of your success. Our built-in history feature saves every single tailored version of your CV. You’ll know exactly which keywords and layout you used for every application, making interview preparation seamless.

records.name: UnityPay — Fair Splits. Zero Arguments.
records.tagline: Split expenses based on what's actually fair
records.description: Most couple finance apps split 50/50 and call it done. UnityPay splits based on what's actually fair — by income, by category, or by your own agreement. Every number is explained. Both partners see exactly why a split is what it is. No hidden math, no assumptions, no arguments. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: PostCopilot AI Threads Generator
records.tagline: Paste any Threads profile. Get viral posts in their style.
records.description: Stop staring at a blank screen. PostCopilot analyzes any Threads creator's profile — topics, style, hooks, engagement — then generates viral posts that sound like them. How it works: Paste a Threads profile URL AI detects their topics + suggests fresh angles Pick a topic or write your own Get 2 unique posts in seconds — copy & share Free. No login. No watermark. Fine-tuned on 1,000+ viral Threads posts.

records.name: Lego
records.tagline: Lego GIF maker
records.description: Build your imagination frame by frame. This bot generates unique, high-quality Lego GIFs from your text. Perfect for fans, creators, and brick lovers!

records.name: cmux
records.tagline: The open-source terminal built for coding agents
records.description: cmux is the open-source terminal built for multitasking with coding agents. It has vertical tabs, notifications, a built-in browser, and it's built on Ghostty. When Claude Code needs you, the pane glows blue and the sidebar tells you why. No Electron/Tauri. Just Swift/Appkit.
